name: Cheech & Chong - 2g D.A.V.E Vapes - Pink Champagne
description:
Crisp, sweet, and a little celebratory. The Cheech & Chong Pink Champagne D.A.V.E vape packs 2 grams of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — into a sleek, ready-to-go device. No cartridges, no setup, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Pink Champagne pours on a bright, bubbly profile: sweet berry and white grape up front with soft floral notes and a crisp, effervescent finish. It's a light, refined flavor made for anyone who likes their sessions smooth, sweet, and easy-drinking.

Why you'll love it:

2G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Pink Champagne flavor — sweet berry and white grape with a crisp, bubbly finish
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Bright flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Cheech & Chong Pink Champagne is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
